event: He unhoods the lantern and moves its honest heat, hand over hand, into the maul's cold core.

changes.note: Carrying the lantern's heat into the core

event: He stops short of full to keep the light; the lantern sinks dimmer, but alive.
He lashes the winding-drum core to the chain's free end, opposite the maul's head.
Gripping near the core, he spins the maul out wide: enormous, slow, nearly past holding.
Under the spin the drum's stored force torques against him, sealed shut to his ember.
